title: COPY Bulk Load
description: Use COPY for high-performance data loading and unloading.

data.text: COPY is the fastest way to load and unload large datasets.

data.title: COPY
data.code: \COPY products FROM '/tmp/products.csv' WITH (FORMAT csv, HEADER true, DELIMITER ',')

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use COPY, not INSERT, for bulk loads over 10,000 rows.
